headline: **MLB Daily Recap**
article:
The Miami Marlins secured a 4-1 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Max Meyer earning the win after pitching 7.0 innings with 7 strikeouts. Esteury Ruiz led the Marlins' offense with a home run and 1 RBI. In other action, the Detroit Tigers took down the Tampa Bay Rays 7-2, with Dillon Dingler leading the offense and Troy Melton dominating on the mound.

Several players have been moved to the injured list, including Jonathan India of the Kansas City Royals, who was transferred to the 60-day injured list due to a left shoulder subluxation. Trevor Story of the Boston Red Sox was also transferred to the 60-day injured list with a sports hernia. The Atlanta Braves transferred Sean Murphy to the 60-day injured list with a fractured left middle finger.

The Cincinnati Reds traded RHP Kyle Nicolas to the Baltimore Orioles for cash, while the Los Angeles Angels traded C Austin Wynns to the Atlanta Braves for cash. The Minnesota Twins traded RHP Simeon Woods Richardson to the Toronto Blue Jays for cash, and RHP Justin Lawrence to the Minnesota Twins for cash.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Nationals 4-1**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a 4-1 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Max Meyer earning the win after pitching 7.0 innings with 7 strikeouts. Esteury Ruiz led the Marlins' offense with a home run and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Rays 7-2**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a 7-2 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays, with Dillon Dingler leading the offense and Troy Melton dominating on the mound.

top_news.title: **White Sox Shut Out Twins 8-0**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox dominated the Minnesota Twins, securing an 8-0 victory. Andrew Benintendi led the offense with a home run and two RBIs, while Grant Taylor pitched a strong 2.0 innings in relief.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Mariners 7-1**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured a 7-1 victory over the Seattle Mariners, with Freddy Peralta earning the win after pitching 6.0 innings with 6 strikeouts and 1 earned run. J.P. Crawford led the Mariners' offense with 3 hits, including a home run.

top_news.title: **Padres Fall Short in Philly**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies edged out the San Diego Padres 6-4, handing them their latest loss. Impact players for the Phillies included Alec Bohm and Bryson Stott, while Manny Machado and Jackson Merrill led the Padres' offense.

top_news.title: **Orioles Sweep Red Sox Behind Strong Offense**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles dominated the Boston Red Sox, winning 8-2 in the final game. Taylor Ward, Pete Alonso, and Willson Contreras led the Orioles' impact hitters.

top_news.title: **Royals Update: Jonathan India to 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Kansas City Royals second baseman Jonathan India has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to a left shoulder subluxation. This move comes after initially being placed on the 10-day injured list.

top_news.title: **Reds Make Roster Move**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds have made a trade, sending RHP Kyle Nicolas to the Baltimore Orioles in exchange for cash.
